README.md:
# Your lab

Review plan.json and the Ansible roles before applying.
Publish this repository at the Git URL in the plan before applying Argo CD.
Run bromigos lab provision apply --repo <this-folder> to converge again.
Removing a service from the selection leaves its data and running resources in place.
ansible/ansible.cfg:
[defaults]
roles_path = roles
host_key_checking = True
retry_files_enabled = False
ansible/roles/agents/tasks/main.json:
[
  {
    "ansible.builtin.command": {
      "argv": [
        "helm",
        "status",
        "lab-agents",
        "-n",
        "lab-agents",
        "-o",
        "json",
        "--kubeconfig",
        "/tmp/example-kubeconfig",
        "--kube-context",
        "example"
      ]
    },
    "changed_when": false,
    "failed_when": false,
    "name": "Read agents release ownership",
    "register": "agent_release"
  },
  {
    "ansible.builtin.assert": {
      "that": [
        "agent_release.rc != 0 or (agent_release.stdout | from_json).info.description == 'bromigos-lab-provision'"
      ]
    },
    "name": "Check agents ownership"
  },
  {
    "ansible.builtin.command": {
      "argv": [
        "python3",
        "-c",
        "import os, subprocess, sys\nenv = dict(os.environ, HELM_DEBUG='false')\nversion = subprocess.run(['helm', 'version', '--short'], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)\nargs = sys.argv[1:]\nif version.returncode:\n    print('bromigos-helm: version check failed'); sys.exit(1)\nif version.stdout.strip().startswith('v4.'):\n    args += ['--server-side=false']\nresult = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)\nif result.returncode:\n    output = (result.stdout + result.stderr).lower()\n    reasons = [('conflict', 'ownership conflict'), ('another operation', 'release busy'),\n               ('immutable', 'immutable field'), ('already exists', 'resource exists'),\n               ('forbidden', 'permission refused'), ('timed out', 'readiness timeout'),\n               ('deadline exceeded', 'readiness timeout'), ('connection refused', 'connection refused')]\n    category = next((label for pattern, label in reasons if pattern in output), 'upgrade failed')\n    print('bromigos-helm: ' + category)\nelse:\n    print('bromigos-helm: applied')\nsys.exit(result.returncode)\n",
        "helm",
        "upgrade",
        "--install",
        "lab-agents",
        "{{ playbook_dir }}/../../helm/agents",
        "--namespace",
        "lab-agents",
        "--create-namespace",
        "--description",
        "bromigos-lab-provision",
        "--kubeconfig",
        "/tmp/example-kubeconfig",
        "--kube-context",
        "example",
        "--wait",
        "--timeout",
        "10m",
        "--values",
        "{{ playbook_dir }}/../../helm/hermes/values.yaml",
        "--values",
        "{{ playbook_dir }}/../../helm/openclaw/values.yaml"
      ]
    },
    "changed_when": false,
    "name": "Converge agents",
    "no_log": false
  }
]
